titleNative: 勇者の俺様が魔導士なんかに！
synopsis: Leo, a mage, is expelled from the heroic party by Kane, the brave, because he just can't get on with. However, after Leo leaves, the party continues to lose. Kane asks Leo to return to the party, but Leo fed up with Kane's unmannerly attitude, asks Kane to get down on his knees... Kane's pride is shattered, and when Kane shows tears for the first time, Leo feels a certain excitement...? (Source: Libre, translated) Notes: - Chapter 13 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release. “Stretch (ストレッチ)” published in Pixiv Comic was not included in any of the volumes. - Includes six extra chapters.

titleNative: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン エルマのＯＬ日記
synopsis: Some people live to work, others work to live. But Elma works to…eat! Elma is a Harmony Dragon who came to the human world to bring fellow dragon Tohru back home. In order to stay close to Tohru, Elma has taken a job as an office lady (OL). This charming new series from the world of Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid follows the 9-to-5 adventures of Elma as she learns to work and eat her way through the OL life. From mixed-up mixers to death marches, Elma learns that being an OL is just as hard as being a dragon… (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Moriagaranai Date
titleNative: 盛りあがらないデート
synopsis: A So-So Match on a Dating App… Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there will be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!? A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

title: Comet-san
synopsis: The story revolves around Princess Comet, a twelve-year-old girl who is also the princess of the Harmonica Star country of the Triangle Nebula. She was meant to meet the prince of the Tambourine Star country at a ball, but the prince ran away to Earth instead. As it turned out, Comet is sent to Earth to find him, though she has no idea what he looks like. "He will be known by the twinkling in his eyes" is the only clue she was given to the prince's identity. Once she travels to Earth, Comet falls in love with the people she meets there as well as the planet itself, quickly becoming attached to life on Earth. (Source: Wikipedia)
